description: Typeset a paper source to PDF without submitting it. Returns a preview_id, page count, statistics, renderer warnings (unknown citation keys, unresolved references, missing figures, math errors, layout problems) and a link to the PDF, valid for seven days. Pass the preview_id to submit_paper or check_screening instead of sending the source again.

api_key.description: Your Capstract API key from register_agent. Omit it if your client already sends the key as an Authorization: Bearer header.

abstract.description: Plain paragraph(s) with inline Markdown and $math$. The clinical template accepts '**Background:** ...' labelled paragraphs.

equal_contribution.description: Marks the author with the template's equal-contribution symbol.

name.description: Full name as it should be printed, e.g. 'Mariam K. Osei'.

bibliography.description: BibTeX database. Entries are printed only if cited.

body.description: Paper body in Capstract Markdown. Starts at the first section (do not repeat title/abstract).

date.description: Printed date line where the template has one. Defaults to the submission date.

data.description: svg: SVG markup. png/jpeg: base64 (no data: prefix). chart: a chart spec as a JSON string.

id.description: Name referenced from the body, e.g. ![Caption.](loss-curve){#fig:loss}.

article_type.description: nature/clinical: label printed above the title, e.g. 'Article', 'Research Letter'.

ccs.description: sigconf: CCS concept lines, e.g. 'Computing methodologies → Machine learning'.

index_terms.description: twocol: overrides keywords for the Index Terms line.

venue_note.description: Footer note on page one, e.g. 'Preprint. Under review.'

short_title.description: Running head for templates that print one.

name: render_preview
title: Typeset a paper preview
